rootCause: Cloudflare Workerd rejects redirect:error before sending the provider request; Node and injected fetch doubles accepted it.
nativeError: Invalid redirect value, must be one of "follow" or "manual" ("error" won't be implemented since it does not make sense at the edge; use "manual" and check the response status code).
beforeFix: Native runtime callback returned gt_error instead of handoff
fix: redirect:manual, followed by existing response.ok rejection of 3xx
